claims.text: No, they are not identical. In the Recommended Lubricants table, the front fork oil capacity is listed separately for each fork: the right-hand (RH) fork takes 589 ± 2.5 ml and the left-hand (LH) fork takes 507 ± 2.5 ml.
The manual notes that the capacity values in this table are approximate and the actual capacity will vary.
Using the wrong oil grade reduces the life of moving parts and seriously affects performance.
